summary: Paranovus Entertainment Technology Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its purchase of a secured convertible promissory note from Knox Golf Academy, Inc. for up to $1,000,000, funded in two tranches of $500,000 each. The note bears 10% interest, matures in 12 months, and is convertible into Knox common stock at Paranovus's election based on renovation costs. Collateral includes all Knox assets and an 80% shareholder guarantee. This is a routine investment/credit facility, not a special situation.
